subtitles.zh: 台积电月度销售额增长45%，这显然表明在7月市场波动显著的背景下，AI硬件需求依然强劲。
subtitles.en: So, TSMC reporting a 45% rise in monthly sales in a sign, of course, of sustained demand for AI hardware amid that market volatility that we saw that was so pronounced in July.

subtitles.zh: 此前，台积电在上个月上调了全年支出预测，当时市场质疑其AI相关支出能否带来可观回报。
subtitles.en: The report comes after TSMC raised its spending projection for the year last month when it faced questions on whether it's AI-related expenditure would deliver meaningful returns.

subtitles.zh: 我们邀请到彭博高级策略师Neil Campling，Neil，请分析一下台积电的数据。我们看到欧洲相关权益资产因此有所上涨。
subtitles.en: We're joined now by Bloomberg, senior stressors, Neil Campling, Neil walk us through the numbers from TSMC. We are seeing a bit of a lift then for European names on the back of this.

subtitles.zh: 市场对此反应积极。月度销售增长45%，分析师预计整个季度增长约47%。
subtitles.en: It seems to be red positive by the market so far. Yeah, so 45% for the monthly sales data, analysts are at about 47% for the full quarter when it comes out,

subtitles.zh: 对于一家万亿美元市值的公司来说，这是相当高的增长率。
subtitles.en: to put that in perspective for a trillion dollar company. That's a pretty high growth rate.

subtitles.zh: 这有望成为自2022年第三季度以来最高的营收，即四年最佳。
subtitles.en: And it's on track to be the highest top line number since Q3 2022, so the best in four years.

subtitles.zh: 这为欧洲芯片设备股提供了有力支撑。
subtitles.en: So that's a very supportive of that, helping the chip equipment stocks today in Europe.

subtitles.zh: 对于这些芯片设备股，别忘了应用材料等公司，它们与ASML最接近，本周晚些时候将公布业绩。
subtitles.en: And for those chip equipment stocks, let's remember that we have the likes of Applied Materials, ASML's closest comp, really, reporting results later this week.

subtitles.zh: 本周美国其他公司的财报也将提供更多AI相关线索。
subtitles.en: And we'll get other AI clues from other earnings in the US this week.

subtitles.zh: 让我们看看台积电为谁制造芯片，因为这是关键所在。
subtitles.en: Let's see the TSMC make chips for, because this is the critical thing here it isn't.

subtitles.zh: 台积电为英伟达和AMD制造AI芯片，也为苹果的智能手机制造芯片。
subtitles.en: TSMC are making AI chips for Nvidia, they're making the chips for AMD, they also make the chips for the smartphones for Apple.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们不是内存交易，内存交易的波动性更大。
subtitles.en: So they're not the memory trade, which is where there's a lot more volatility around.
